_comment: X-ray writer SFT (fora_report.cxr.train_sft), trained from the base Gemma-4-31B-it without any warm start. 32 nodes x 4 GPUs = world 128, one study per GPU per step: 257,595 train studies -> 2,013 steps per epoch, 4,026 optimizer steps. --locations = locations_train.npz,locations_val.npz from fora_report.cxr.dump_locations. The schedule depends on the world size.
